CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_scenario_decision(p_run_id uuid, p_scenario_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('run',to_jsonb(p),'persona',to_jsonb(pe),
   'response',saved.items->0->'response','response_text',saved.items->0->'response_text',
   'response_count',saved.n)
 FROM public.playthroughs p
 JOIN public.scenarios s ON s.scenario_id=p.current_scenario_id AND s.version_id=p.version_id
 LEFT JOIN public.personas pe ON pe.persona_id=p.persona_id AND pe.version_id=p.version_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*) AS n,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('response',to_jsonb(pr),'response_text',ch.response_text)
     ORDER BY pr.answered_at,pr.response_id) AS items
   FROM public.player_responses pr JOIN public.choices ch ON ch.choice_id=pr.choice_id
   WHERE pr.playthrough_id=p.playthrough_id AND ch.scenario_id=s.scenario_id
 ) saved
 WHERE p.playthrough_id=p_run_id AND p.current_scenario_id=p_scenario_id
 AND p.owner_user_id=auth.uid() AND coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false)
 AND p.session_id IS NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.manage_scheduled_scenario_progression()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE candidates integer; selected_id uuid; library_edition boolean;
BEGIN
 IF OLD.current_scenario_id IS NOT NULL
 AND (NEW.current_day IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.current_day OR NEW.employment_state->>'stage'='complete')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.player_responses pr JOIN public.choices c ON c.choice_id=pr.choice_id
 WHERE pr.playthrough_id=OLD.playthrough_id AND c.scenario_id=OLD.current_scenario_id AND pr.version_id=OLD.version_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Complete the current scenario before continuing'; END IF;
 IF NEW.current_day IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.current_day THEN NEW.current_scenario_id:=NULL; END IF;
 IF NEW.current_scenario_id IS NULL AND NEW.employment_state->>'stage'='day' AND NEW.status='active'
 AND NEW.current_day BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND NEW.current_day<>2
 AND (NEW.current_day<>3 OR NEW.employment_state->>'hiredDay'='2') THEN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.playthrough_expenses e WHERE e.playthrough_id=NEW.playthrough_id AND e.due_day=NEW.current_day)
   THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
   SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenario_library_metadata m WHERE m.version_id=NEW.version_id) INTO library_edition;
   IF library_edition THEN
     SELECT s.scenario_id INTO selected_id
     FROM public.scenarios s JOIN public.scenario_library_metadata m USING(scenario_id,version_id)
     JOIN public.content_versions v USING(version_id)
     WHERE s.version_id=NEW.version_id AND s.persona_intent=NEW.persona_id
       AND v.status='published' AND v.published_at IS NOT NULL AND m.enabled AND m.engine='ordinary'
       AND (NOT m.requires_employment OR NEW.current_job_id IS NOT NULL)
       AND ((s.schedule_type='scheduled' AND s.default_day=NEW.current_day)
         OR (s.schedule_type='non_scheduled' AND m.library_key<>'D005'))
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.player_responses pr JOIN public.choices c ON c.choice_id=pr.choice_id
         WHERE pr.playthrough_id=NEW.playthrough_id AND c.scenario_id=s.scenario_id AND pr.version_id=NEW.version_id)
     ORDER BY (s.schedule_type='scheduled') DESC,md5(NEW.playthrough_id::text||NEW.current_day::text||s.scenario_id::text)
     LIMIT 1;
     IF selected_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No eligible unused scenario for this day'; END IF;
   ELSE
     SELECT count(*),(array_agg(s.scenario_id))[1] INTO candidates,selected_id
     FROM public.scenarios s JOIN public.content_versions v ON v.version_id=s.version_id
     WHERE s.version_id=NEW.version_id AND s.persona_intent=NEW.persona_id
       AND s.schedule_type='scheduled' AND s.default_day=NEW.current_day
       AND v.status='published' AND v.published_at IS NOT NULL;
     IF candidates>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Multiple scheduled scenarios for this persona/day'; END IF;
   END IF;
   NEW.current_scenario_id:=selected_id;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.name: manage_scheduled_scenario_progression

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION group_private.read_session_state_month(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare base jsonb; s public.group_sessions; member_id uuid;
begin
  base := group_private.read_session_state_setup(p_session_id);
  if base ? 'error' then return base; end if;
  select * into s from public.group_sessions where session_id = p_session_id;
  select participant_id into member_id from public.group_participants
    where session_id = p_session_id and user_id = auth.uid();
  return base || jsonb_build_object(
    'roundType', s.round_type,
    'currentDay', case when s.round_type = 'scenario' then s.current_question_number else 0 end,
    'totalDayCount', 30,
    'selectedJobId', (select job_id from public.group_job_votes
      where session_id = p_session_id and participant_id = member_id),
    'winningJobId', case when s.round_type = 'job' and s.round_state = 'results'
      then (select job_id from public.group_job_votes where session_id = p_session_id
        group by job_id order by count(*) desc, job_id limit 1)
      else s.selected_job_id end,
    'voteCount', case when s.round_type = 'job' then
      (select count(*)::integer from public.group_job_votes where session_id = p_session_id)
      else (base->>'voteCount')::integer end,
    'jobs', case when s.round_type = 'job' then (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'jobId', j.job_id,
        'title', j.title,
        'description', j.description,
        'hoursPerWeek', j.hours_per_week,
        'weeklyGrossIncome', j.weekly_gross_income,
        'voteCount', case when s.round_state in ('results', 'completed') then
          (select count(*) from public.group_job_votes v
           where v.session_id = p_session_id and v.job_id = j.job_id)
          else null end
      ) order by j.title), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.jobs j where j.version_id = s.version_id and j.is_active
    ) else null end
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION group_private.read_session_state(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare base jsonb; s public.group_sessions; member_id uuid; own_option text;
begin
  base := group_private.read_session_state_month(p_session_id);
  if base ? 'error' then return base; end if;
  select * into s from public.group_sessions where session_id = p_session_id;
  select participant_id into member_id from public.group_participants
    where session_id = p_session_id and user_id = auth.uid();
  if s.round_type in ('preparation', 'clothing') then
    select option_id into own_option from public.group_employment_votes
    where session_id = p_session_id and participant_id = member_id and stage = s.round_type;
  end if;
  return base || jsonb_build_object(
    'cacSupportEnabled', s.cac_support_enabled,
    'sharedHouseholdId', s.selected_persona_id,
    'sharedHouseholdName', (select name from public.personas where persona_id = s.selected_persona_id),
    'sharedBalance', s.shared_balance,
    'employmentStage', s.employment_stage,
    'employmentAttempt', s.employment_attempt,
    'employmentPrepared', s.employment_prepared,
    'clothingChoice', s.clothing_choice,
    'interviewHired', s.interview_hired,
    'weeklyIncome', s.weekly_income,
    'selectedEmploymentOption', own_option,
    'householdVotes', case when s.round_state = 'lobby' then (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'householdId', p.persona_id, 'householdName', p.name,
        'voteCount', (select count(*) from public.group_participants gp
          where gp.session_id = p_session_id and gp.persona_id = p.persona_id)
      ) order by p.name), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.personas p where p.version_id = s.version_id
    ) else null end,
    'employmentOptions', case
      when s.round_type = 'preparation' then jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object('optionId','prepare','text','Join CAC Adult Education classes',
          'voteCount',case when s.round_state='results' then (select count(*) from public.group_employment_votes where session_id=p_session_id and stage='preparation' and option_id='prepare') else null end),
        jsonb_build_object('optionId','skip','text','Continue without classes',
          'voteCount',case when s.round_state='results' then (select count(*) from public.group_employment_votes where session_id=p_session_id and stage='preparation' and option_id='skip') else null end)
      )
      when s.round_type = 'clothing' then (
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('optionId', x.option_id, 'text', x.label,
          'cost', x.cost, 'voteCount', case when s.round_state='results' then
            (select count(*) from public.group_employment_votes v where v.session_id=p_session_id and v.stage='clothing' and v.option_id=x.option_id) else null end) order by x.sort)
        from (values
          ('purchase','Buy professional clothes',60::numeric,1),
          ('current','Make our current clothes work',0::numeric,2),
          ('cac','Use the CAC clothing closet',0::numeric,3),
          ('owned','Wear our professional clothes',0::numeric,4)
        ) x(option_id,label,cost,sort)
        where (s.clothing_choice in ('purchase','cac') and x.option_id='owned')
           or (s.clothing_choice is null and x.option_id in ('purchase','current'))
           or (s.clothing_choice is null and s.cac_support_enabled and x.option_id='cac')
      ) else null end,
    'voteCount', case when s.round_type in ('preparation','clothing') then
      (select count(*)::integer from public.group_employment_votes where session_id=p_session_id and stage=s.round_type)
      else (base->>'voteCount')::integer end,
    'sharedExpenses', case when s.selected_persona_id is not null then (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('expenseId', expense_id, 'name', name,
        'amount', amount, 'firstDueDay', first_due_day, 'repeatIntervalDays', repeat_interval_days)
        order by first_due_day, name), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.persona_expenses where persona_id=s.selected_persona_id and version_id=s.version_id
    ) else null end
  );
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_fresh_employment_run()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- Recheck the insertion invariants even for paths which bypass INSERT RLS.
  -- Nonparticipant/maintenance inserts are left untouched, never auto-stamped.
  if auth.uid() is null or new.owner_user_id is distinct from auth.uid()
     or coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false) is not true
     or new.started_at is null then return new; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.personas p join public.content_versions v on v.version_id=p.version_id
      where p.persona_id=new.persona_id and p.version_id=new.version_id
      and v.status='published' and v.published_at is not null
      and new.current_balance=coalesce(p.general_starting_balance,0)) then return new; end if;
  if new.employment_state is null and new.status = 'active' and new.current_day = 1
     and new.current_job_id is null and new.current_scenario_id is null
     and new.session_id is null and new.cac_support_enabledabled is null then
    update public.playthroughs set employment_state = jsonb_build_object(
      'engine','employment-v1','schemaVersion',1,'revision',0,'stage','uninitialized','receipts','{}'::jsonb)
    where playthrough_id = new.playthrough_id and owner_user_id=auth.uid();
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.initialize_fresh_bill_schedule()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- NEW is the original insert tuple: independent of the employment AFTER INSERT
 -- trigger's update and of alphabetical AFTER INSERT trigger ordering.
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NEW.owner_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()
 OR coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false) IS NOT TRUE
 OR NEW.started_at IS NULL OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active'
 OR NEW.current_day IS DISTINCT FROM 1 OR NEW.session_id IS NOT NULL
 OR NEW.employment_state IS NOT NULL OR NEW.current_job_id IS NOT NULL
 OR NEW.current_scenario_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.cac_support_enabledabled IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fresh anonymous individual playthrough required';
 END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.content_versions WHERE version_id=NEW.version_id FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.personas p JOIN public.content_versions v USING(version_id)
   WHERE p.persona_id=NEW.persona_id AND p.version_id=NEW.version_id
   AND v.status='published' AND v.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND NEW.current_balance=coalesce(p.general_starting_balance,0)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Published persona and valid starting balance required'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.playthroughs WHERE playthrough_id=NEW.playthrough_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public.persona_expenses e
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(e.first_due_day::integer,30,
     coalesce(e.repeat_interval_days::integer,31)) d(day)
   JOIN public.scenarios s ON s.version_id=e.version_id AND s.persona_intent=e.persona_id
     AND s.schedule_type='scheduled' AND s.default_day=d.day
   WHERE e.persona_id=NEW.persona_id AND e.version_id=NEW.version_id
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bill and ordinary scenario schedule collision'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.playthrough_expenses(playthrough_id,expense_id,due_day,amount_due,
   version_id,name_snapshot,late_fee_amount)
 SELECT NEW.playthrough_id,e.expense_id,d.day,e.amount,e.version_id,e.name,e.late_fee_amount
 FROM public.persona_expenses e
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(e.first_due_day::integer,30,
   coalesce(e.repeat_interval_days::integer,31)) d(day)
 WHERE e.persona_id=NEW.persona_id AND e.version_id=NEW.version_id;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.name: initialize_fresh_bill_schedule

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_bill_snapshot(p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('run',to_jsonb(p),'bills',b.items,'paid_total',b.paid_total,
   'overdue_total',b.overdue_total,'outstanding_total',b.outstanding_total,
   'upcoming_total',b.upcoming_total,'scenario_income',s.income,'scenario_charged',s.charged)
 FROM public.playthroughs p
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.due_day,e.playthrough_expense_id),'[]'::jsonb) items,
     coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN e.amount_due+
       CASE WHEN e.ignored_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE e.late_fee_amount END ELSE 0 END),0) paid_total,
     coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.paid_at IS NULL AND e.ignored_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN e.amount_due+e.late_fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) overdue_total,
     coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.paid_at IS NULL AND e.due_day<=p.current_day THEN e.amount_due+
       CASE WHEN e.ignored_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE e.late_fee_amount END ELSE 0 END),0) outstanding_total,
     coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.paid_at IS NULL AND e.due_day>p.current_day THEN e.amount_due ELSE 0 END),0) upcoming_total
   FROM public.playthrough_expenses e WHERE e.playthrough_id=p.playthrough_id AND e.version_id=p.version_id
 ) b
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(pr.balance_change_applied,0)),0) income,
     coalesce(sum(greatest(-pr.balance_change_applied,0)),0) charged
   FROM public.player_responses pr WHERE pr.playthrough_id=p.playthrough_id AND pr.version_id=p.version_id
 ) s
 WHERE p.playthrough_id=p_run_id AND p.owner_user_id=auth.uid() AND p.session_id IS NULL
   AND coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_scenario_recap_facts(p_run_id uuid, p_scenario_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(scenario_id uuid, version_id uuid, fact_role text, semantic_key text, display_text text, source_url text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT f.scenario_id,f.version_id,f.fact_role,f.semantic_key,f.display_text,f.source_url
  FROM public.playthroughs p
  JOIN public.scenario_fact_copy f ON f.version_id=p.version_id AND f.scenario_id=p_scenario_id
  JOIN public.scenarios s ON s.scenario_id=f.scenario_id AND s.version_id=f.version_id
  WHERE p.playthrough_id=p_run_id AND p.owner_user_id=auth.uid()
    AND coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,false)
    AND p.session_id IS NULL AND f.verified
    AND (f.fact_role='general' OR p.cac_support_enabledabled IS TRUE)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.player_responses pr JOIN public.choices c ON c.choice_id=pr.choice_id
      WHERE pr.playthrough_id=p.playthrough_id AND pr.version_id=p.version_id
        AND c.scenario_id=f.scenario_id AND c.version_id=p.version_id
    )
  ORDER BY f.fact_role DESC;
$function$
functions.name: get_scenario_recap_facts
